expects.rule: Online booking is one tap away from every screen (header button on phone and desktop), and phone or messaging is offered for those who prefer it.
Prices are published, at least as from-prices per service, with what makes them vary (length, stylist level, time).
Opening hours, the street address with a map link and the phone number are plain text on the home page, per location when there are several.
Photographs show the real salon, the real team and real client results, not stock models.
Each stylist or therapist is named with a photograph and a specialty, and can be booked directly when clients choose a person.
Consultation, deposit and cancellation rules (for colour, extensions, treatments) are stated before booking.

traits: 7 of 10 hand booking to a third-party tool rather than an on-site form: Timma and Bokadirekt (ALICE), Timely (Una), Booksy (Atelier Brzozowski), Mangomint (M Coupe, Muse), Squire (CRISP), Fresha (Venetian); Goldust has its own /book pages, Il Colorista and Mistretta route to WhatsApp, a form or a contact page.
7 of 10 give a street address on the home page; Venetian and M Coupe give none, Goldust hides it inside a map link.
5 of 10 list opening hours on the home page (Una, Il Colorista, CRISP, Muse, Mistretta); the others leave them out or on another page.
Only 3 of 10 put actual prices on the home page (CRISP full list by stylist level, Goldust per treatment, Muse as offers); Una, M Coupe and Mistretta say instead what makes the price vary.
4 of 10 are multi-site (Atelier Brzozowski 2, CRISP 3, Venetian 3, Muse 3) and list each location separately, with hours per shop on CRISP and Muse.

Palettes are soft and warm or near-monochrome with one accent: lavender #efeafb (Una), coral #e9584f (Il Colorista), gold #b69f64 (Venetian), blush #d5b8a6 on cream #f5f0e7 (Goldust), sage #62685e and #293223 (Muse); 3 of the 5 read pair a display serif with a sans.

sites.name: ALICE Hair & Art
sites.why: Stockholm salon that doubles as a gallery: an all-text first screen, 'The seamless blend of hairdressing & art', a three-item nav (Info, Hair, & Art), then a book block with each of three stylists linked to their own booking page (Timma, Bokadirekt). Address on Regeringsgatan as text, email and Instagram; no prices or hours. Near-black #121212 on light grey #f0f0f0, Inter (Framer).

sites.name: Una
sites.why: Auckland hair studio: header with Menu and a 'Book an appointment' button to Timely; headline 'There is no one quite like you. You are one. You are Una.' and the founder introduced by name. Hours (Tue-Sat, Sun-Mon closed), address with a parking link, phone and email are in the header and footer. Prices explained (depend on length, thickness, time) with a free consultation. Lavender #efeafb, PP Eiko serif with PP Neue Montreal.

sites.name: Il Colorista Salon
sites.why: Colour salon in Isola della Scala near Verona: H1 'Atelier a Isola della Scala' over a carousel of salon photographs, the line 'Ogni donna ha il suo colore', services (consulenza, colore, balayage...), the two staff named with photographs, a seasonal magazine as PDF. Footer: every day 8:30-18:30, address, tap-to-call and WhatsApp. Coral accent #e9584f on #1f1f1f text. No prices, no book button.

sites.name: Atelier Brzozowski
sites.why: Two hair salons in Gdańsk and Gdynia: logo and a short paragraph on haircutting as a craft, nav split by city (Stylists and Contact each have Gdynia and Gdańsk), a Rezerwacja block with one 'Zarezerwuj online' button per salon to Booksy, each address with a tap-to-call number. Price list on its own page; shop on a separate domain.

sites.name: M Coupe
sites.why: Quebec City salon, French only: header with four links and a 'Prendre Rendez-vous' button to Mangomint, repeated in each service section; black-and-white and colour photographs; 'Services personnalisés pour vous!' with tabs (Coupe et Stylisme, Barbershop, Coloration, Extensions, Soins). Extensions state a 45-minute consultation and a deposit. No hours, address or phone on the home page.

sites.name: CRISP Barbershop
sites.why: Montreal barbershops: full-width shop photograph, 'MORE THAN A BARBER SHOP' and BOOK NOW, with BOOK in the header (all to Squire). A full price list by stylist level (Stylist, Junior Stylist, Junior Barber, haircut 50/40/25 $, plus taxes), three shops each with address linked to Maps and hours per day, portfolio and academy. No phone number shown.

sites.name: Venetian Nail Spa
sites.why: Winnipeg nail spa with three mall locations: 'A REFINED GLOW, THE VENETIAN WAY' over a row of images, 'Book Your Experience' and a header Book Now to Fresha, 'over 1,000 five-star reviews' and four testimonials, a location picker in the contact form. Gold #b69f64, Beautique Display with Inter. No prices, hours, address or phone, and the mobile menu's Book Now links to '#'.

sites.name: Goldust Spa
sites.why: Day spa in Canggu, Bali: on load a panel asks 'What can we help you with today?' with five choices (book a treatment, spa party, gift card, menu, collaborate), then 'Welcome to Goldust' over rotating photographs and an 'Enter with music / silence' choice. Treatments carry duration and price (IDR 650k++), each with its own book button; WhatsApp number in header and footer. Blush #d5b8a6 on cream #f5f0e7, Pangaia serif. No hours.

sites.name: Muse Laser & Spa
sites.why: Laser and skin clinics in Chicago and two suburbs: 'Be your own Muse', a Book now button (Mangomint), quick links to six treatments, a badge row (500+ Google reviews, 5000+ clients), special offers with prices ($299 first microneedling), a free-consult form, and three clinic cards with address, hours per day and phone. Sage #62685e and dark green #293223 on #f3f3f3, Sigurd Knight with Manrope.

sites.name: Mistretta Coiffure
sites.why: Hair and beauty salon in Lugano-Paradiso: 'Mistretta Coiffure 2026' with a carousel of yearly looks, services (hair, photo shoots, wedding looks, make-up), See pricelist and Book appointment buttons (booking goes to the contact page), trends by year, a See on map button. Hours per day (Monday on request), address and phone in text; EN, DE, IT. Navy #313357. Some product tiles are empty and one heading reads 'Weeding look'.

avoid: A Book button that links to '#' or to a contact page, or a booking widget that only appears on desktop.
No prices anywhere, not even from-prices, with 'contact us' as the only answer.
Hours, address and phone missing from the home page, or present only inside a map link.
Stock photographs of models instead of the salon, the team and real client results.
Typos and empty image tiles left from the template (a misspelt service heading, blank partner logos).
An intro gate (sound choice, full-screen animation) that delays the booking button on phone.
Several locations merged into one contact form, with no per-location address, hours and phone.

sources.name: Salon Business, Phorest 2025 consumer insights (UK and Ireland)
